title: Following backlash against its education updates, Google says schools can choose to enable Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Search individually (Isabel O'Brien/CNBC)
summary: Isabel O'Brien / CNBC: Following backlash against its education updates, Google says schools can choose to enable Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Search individually — Google is playing defense on Tuesday after a political backlash to its new policy surrounding use of artificial intelligence in schools.
